payload.summary: Ward mockups end-to-end suite: 15 genuine assertion failures on its first full run, including four referral-board columns unreachable at 641px
payload.detail: FIRST FULL RUN OF THE chromium-mockups PROJECT recorded here. 2026-09-10, at 8b4b96fa9c, against a dev server, workers=1, 10.9 minutes. RECONCILED: 171 declared, 171 run — 151 passed + 15 failed + 5 skipped. Playwright exit 1 (note: a wrapper's own exit code read 0, because the compound command ended in echo; read the recorded exit= line, not the task status). ALL 15 ARE ASSERTION FAILURES — toHaveURL, toHaveCount, toBeVisible, toEqual, element(s) not found. ZERO browser-loss or timeout. That is materially different from the previously recorded state of this suite (2026-09-06: 78 tests, 1 failure that WAS a browser lost under memory pressure), so the old single-occurrence flake note does not describe this run and must not be used to explain it away. THREE ARE WARD. (a) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:1056 — 'column(s) of ward-referral-board-queued-table are off the screen at 641px, reachable only by scrolling sideways inside a table', expected 1, received 4. This is a REAL REACHABILITY DEFECT and it is the predictable consequence of an APPROVED change: docs/ward-flow/design/owner-ruling-2026-09-07-board-columns.md approved five new columns (Presentation, Review status, Plan, Bed number, Legal form expiry). The ruling approved the columns; nobody ruled on their reachability at narrow widths. Same shape as the phone-bar defect of 2026-09-08 — present in the DOM, not reachable by a coordinator. (b) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:414 — 'fixture assumption: the seed's queued referrals, in the queue's own order', expected 0 received 2. (c) ui-ward-roles.spec.ts:559 — getByTestId('ward-ed-inbox-empty') not found for peel-ed. (b) and (c) both look like the seed having moved under stale fixtures rather than UI defects, but which side is right is unconfirmed. TWELVE ARE OUTSIDE WARD FLOW and need routing to their owners: ui-caring-contact-mockup (4), ui-tools-collapse (3), ui-tools-task-directory (2), ui-sidebar-live-mockup (2), ui-answer-chat-perfected-mockup (1). ⚠️ SCOPE LIMITS, STATED SO THEY ARE NOT WRITTEN WIDER: ONE run only — no claim is made about stability or flakiness in either direction, and repository policy still needs three reproductions on one SHA before any quarantine. And because this suite is selected by NEITHER verify:ui path (test:e2e:pr takes --project=chromium and the seeded project, and grep-inverts @mockup), these failures may be weeks old; nothing here asserts a recent regression. NEXT ACTION: owner deferred routing on 2026-09-10; route the three ward failures and record the twelve others when he picks it up.
